result.title: AmodalBox: Automated 3D Bounding Box Annotation under Partial Visibility
result.summary: Recent progress in vision foundation models (VFMs) has made automated open-vocabulary 3D bounding box annotation increasingly feasible by jointly leveraging LiDAR point clouds and images. However, partial observations remain a major challenge in sparse driving scenes, where visible LiDAR points often cover only a small fraction of the object's surface and provide insufficient cues for estimating its full spatial extent. As a result, existing methods often produce mislocalized boxes or leave objects unlabeled. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{\Ours{}}, an automated annotation framework that leverages image-generated 3D assets as amodal geometric priors for partially observed objects. By establishing correspondences between input images and rendered views of 3D assets, \Ours{} robustly aligns canonical amodal geometry with partially observed world-space LiDAR point clouds. To improve temporal consistency and reduce computational cost, \Ours{} generates a single asset per instance, estimates its metric scale once at a single frame and propagates it across frames for dynamic instances, and aggregates multi-frame observations for static instances. 3D object detectors trained on annotations from \Ours{} improve performance over strong baselines by 14.1 mAP on the nuScenes dataset and by 12.45 AP at IoU 0.5 for the vehicle class on the Waymo Open Dataset (WOD). Our project page is available at: \href{https://oliver0922.github.io/AmodalBox/}{https://oliver0922.github.io/AmodalBox/}

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AmodalBox，用图像生成的 3D 资产作为 amodal 几何先验，与部分可见的 LiDAR 点云对齐，从而自动化标注完整 3D 包围盒，并借单帧尺度估计与跨帧传播提升时序一致性和效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作处理稀疏观测下「可见证据不足以确定完整空间范围」的 amodal 补全问题，其以生成式先验补全未见几何的思路，可能为 LVR 中如何在内部状态表征未被观测到的任务必要视觉信息、筛选视觉证据提供问题表述层面的启发，但领域与 VLM 推理解耦，需较多核查。
